videos.description: We have all been given a legacy! Join me as I share my personal missionary experience growing up in the foreign mission field and my passion for finishing the work we have been tasked to do.

videos.title: Daniel All Access
videos.description: “Thoughts on My Bed, Visions in My Head” is the title of this presentation. Join Pastor CA Murray as he opens Chapter 4 in the book of Daniel. King Nebuchadnezzar seems to be convicted by the power of God in Israel. Although he continues to praise the Lord he eventually turns his back to God yet again. Stay tuned to find how the rest of King Nebuchadnezzar’s story goes.

videos.description: Dive into the stories of the Bible and see its characters come alive! What was it like to walk with Jesus, or hear Him calm the wind in the storm? Join us as we explore the wonders of our God.

videos.title: Bible Treasures
videos.description: Many schools teach that the fossils we find buried in the ground are milllions of years old. But, is that possible? And, is that Biblical?

videos.title: 3ABN Today
videos.description: How do we tell the truth when it’s hard to hear? And what does compassion look like when we disagree? On this episode of 3ABN Today, Pastor Ryan and Anissa Johnson, along with Ian Vandervalk and Fotini Martinez, look at how Jesus treated people and ask whether truth and compassion are really in competition. From the way we listen to the words we choose, they explore what it means to speak the truth in love.

videos.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
videos.description: Discover why correctly understanding biblical prophecy is essential to faith in Jesus Christ. This lesson examines Christ’s encounter with the disciples on the road to Emmaus, where He used Moses and the Prophets to reveal how all Scripture pointed to Him. Their disappointment came from a one-sided interpretation of Messianic prophecy, but Jesus opened their understanding and transformed confusion into conviction. videos.description: Pentecost was more than a miraculous display of speaking in tongues—it was heaven’s powerful declaration that Jesus Christ was alive, exalted, and reigning at the Father’s right hand! In this 3ABN production, Pastor Louis Torres explores the true significance of the Holy Spirit’s outpouring through Acts 2, Joel’s prophecy, and Peter’s sermon. Just as Jacob knew his son Joseph was alive when he saw the wagons Joseph sent, the disciples received the gift of the Holy Spirit as evidence of Christ’s heavenly enthronement. videos.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
videos.description: On this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q&A, our panel tackles thoughtful viewer questions on Scripture and Christian living. Why are Dan and Ephraim missing from the 12 tribes in Revelation 7? What does “ baptized for the dead” mean, and how can we know if our prayers truly align with God’s will? We’ll also explore why the book of Enoch isn’t in the Bible, whether wedding rings are biblically acceptable, and how Christians can share their faith with atheists. Other topics include the meaning of Romans 1:26–28, how a national Sunday law might be enforced, and the reality of the Mark of the Beast.

Like a brand plucked from the fire, God took Wisam from the life he knew and shaped him into who He called him to be. This is the first installment of Wisam’s incredible journey of faith and victory in Jesus.

videos.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
videos.description: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

videos.title: Behold the Lamb Presents
videos.description: In a world filled with confusion about who God is, the Bible reveals a truth that cannot be shaken: God is our Father. This message, “The Father,” is the third presentation in the series Foundations That Cannot Be Shaken, and it addresses one of the most misunderstood—and most vital—truths in Scripture. From Eden to Calvary, and from the heavenly sanctuary to the final judgment, the great controversy has centered on the character of God the Father.\.
